milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate to and visually locate the green carpet block placed at spawn-relative [6, 0, 6] inside the oak planks building. A max_distance of 5 ensures the player has entered or is at the doorway of the building (close enough to see the carpet on the floor). facing_tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is actually looking toward the carpet, confirming they have found it rather than just passing nearby.
